name: @pipeworx/mcp-bounceban

tools.name: bounceban_verify
tools.description: Verify a single email address via BounceBan's synchronous waterfall endpoint (blocks up to 80s for a definitive result, including catch-all detection). Example: bounceban_verify({ email: "jane@stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-bounceban-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your BounceBan API key (find it at bounceban.com/app/api/settings).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bounceban forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bounceban pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
